COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPSS No. 2240 of 2023 
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Heard Mr. Vinay Kumar, Advocate, for the 
petitioners, Mr. Sushil Vashistha, Standing Counsel 
for the State and Mr. C.K. Sharma, Advocate for 
the private respondents.
2. The petitioners have challenged the 
provisional recommendation made by the 
respondent Commission dated 11.11.2023 
(Annexure-7 to the writ petition) made pursuant to 
the advertisement dated 05.10.2021.
3. It is contention of the learned counsel for the 
petitioners that the petitioners’ name configure in 
the recommendation dated 25.10.2023, but, 
suddenly in the subsequent recommendation list, 
the name of the petitioners were deleted.
4. According to the learned counsel for the 
petitioner, the reason for removal of the name of the 
petitioners from the recommendation list was that 
the petitioners were not having the three years’ 
industrial experience, as required as per the terms 
and conditions of the advertisement.
5. Issue notice to the respondent nos. 4, 5 and 6, 
returnable within six weeks. Steps to be taken 
within a week.
6. The learned counsel for the respondents pray
for and are granted four weeks’ time to file counter  affidavit. Two weeks thereafter, rejoinder affidavit 
may be filed by the petitioners.
7. List this matter on 14.03.2024.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.) 
 14.12.2023
Ujjwal

4. Ms. Devika Tiwari, learned counsel for the 
UKSSSC is directed to assist this Court on behalf of the 
UKSSSC – Recruiting Agency on the next date. 
5. A counter affidavit has been filed by the 
Recruiting Agency but as per counsel for the 
petitioners, statements given in the counter affidavit 
are contrary to the Act and Regulation. If it is so, then it 
is a very serious issue.
6. Ms. Devika Tiwari, learned counsel for the
Recruiting Agency undertakes before this Court that 
she will properly assist this Court and she will sit with 
the Panel Lawyers of the Recruiting Agency and do 
some research work and she will file better affidavit, if 
so required, within fifteen days. 
7. Since procedure adopted by the Recruiting 
Agency is under scrutiny in all these writ petitions, 
therefore, learned Chief Standing Counsel should also 
assist this Court and may also file additional affidavit, 
only with regard to the procedure, which is being 
followed by the recruiting agency. 
8. List on 25.03.2025 at 02.00 p.m. 
9. Interim order, if any, in all the writ petitions shall 
continue till the next date of listing. 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 05.03.2025
